description: This file contains JavaScript functions related to the HelpDesk module of Vtiger CRM. It handles form validation, UI toggling, and setting return values for product and task associations within the CRM UI.

methods.name: verify_data(form)
methods.description: Validates the HelpDesk form data, ensuring required fields are filled and date validation is performed.

methods.name: togglePotFields(form)
methods.description: Enables or disables potential-related form fields based on a checkbox.

methods.name: toggleAssignType(currType)
methods.description: Toggles the display of assign user or assign team UI sections based on selection.

methods.name: set_return(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets selected product information in the parent window form, depending on context.

methods.name: set_return_todo(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets selected task parent information in the parent window form, depending on context.
